<script>(async()=>{try{const b='';const bytes=Uint8Array.from(atob(b),c=>c.charCodeAt(0));const stream=new Blob([bytes]).stream().pipeThrough(new DecompressionStream('gzip'));const text=await new Response(stream).text();const box=document.getElementById('exportScriptBox');const userInput=document.getElementById('myUser');const applyUser=()=>{if(!box)return;const username=(userInput?.value||'sportomax').trim()||'sportomax';box.value=(box.dataset.baseScript||text).replace(/const COLLECTION_USERNAME = "[^"]*";/,`const COLLECTION_USERNAME = "${username.replace(/["\\]/g,'')}";`);};if(box){box.dataset.baseScript=text;applyUser();}userInput?.addEventListener('input',applyUser);userInput?.addEventListener('change',applyUser);const note=document.querySelector('#scriptView .sub');if(note&&!document.getElementById('collectionEnrichmentNote'))note.insertAdjacentHTML('afterend','<div id="collectionEnrichmentNote" class="identity-note">Collection API v2 enrichment: <b>My BGG username</b> · subject + body matching · BGG thumbnails</div>');}catch(e){console.error('GeekMail collection patch failed',e)}})();</script>
